rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a coat worn over the upper body.

example.english: Remember to wear a coat when you go out.
example.jyutping: ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 zoek3 ngoi6 tou3

rows.note: Use this for a coat as an article of clothing, especially a longer or more substantial coat, rather than the everyday default 外套.

example.english: This long coat is perfect for wearing in winter.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 coeng4 lau5 hou2 ngaam1 dung1 tin1 zoek3

rows.note: Use this for a physical layer of material, such as a coat of paint, rather than for clothing.

example.english: The coat of paint isn't dry yet, so don't touch that layer.
example.jyutping: jau4 cat1 mei6 gon1 m4 hou2 dim3 go2 cang4

rows.note: Use this for the fur or feathers covering an animal, rather than for a garment.

example.english: That cat has a thick coat.
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 maau1 ge3 mou4 hou2 hau5
